programmes.d: Part 2 of HMP Shrewsbury sees Karl, Glen, and Stuart explore C-Wing and the execution chamber, seeking answers to decades of terrifying paranormal reports.
Gregg enters the beautiful Townley Hall to look for some of the many spirits that are said to roam its dark corridors.

Glemham Hall is new territory for Most Haunted and Karl and Stuart venture into dark rooms and corridors for the first time. Part 1 sees Karl investigate the deserted servants quarters where some of the toys seem to have a will of their own.
In Part 2 of our investigation into Glemham Hall, Stuart walks the first floor rooms where something seems to be following him.
In Part 3 at Glemham Hall, Karl explores the first-floor bedrooms, where a mischievous spirit quickly makes its presence known.
While Karl walks the first floor, Stuart enters the old servant’s quarters and realises he is not alone for long.
As Karl enters, what seems to be the prison mortuary, he quickly finds out that something is trying to get his attention.
This episode features the following cases: Devil's Tattoo, Static Man, The Bloody Hand, Where Have All the Heroes Gone, War Surplus.
This episode features the following cases: Dead Beat Daddy, Ghost Town, The Sewing Machine, The Sleepwalker, Money Laundry.
This episode features the following cases: The Handyman, Anatole, Makeup Magic, Screwdriver, Charlie.
This episode features the following cases: The Dealer, Gratuity, The Cake, 1st Time Offender, The Mirror of Truth.
Millionaire Matchmaker Patti Stanger reluctantly returns to her former dream home in Marina Del Rey where she was attacked in her bed by an aggressive spirit.

Reality star and host Audrina Patridge returns to an historic pub in Chicago where she was accosted by an angry spirit. Their journey takes an unexpected turn as Psycic Medium Kim Russo uncovers more of Audrina's story.
Music Mogul and rapper T-Pain seeks psychic medium Kim Russo's help in uncovering what is causing the terrifying paranormal activity in his family's home in Roswell, Georgia.
Psychic Medium Kim Russo helps Dancing With The Stars Karina Smirnoff confront the ghosts who are terrorizing her family in their Woodland Hills, California home.
Meatloaf returns to the famous Bearsville NY recording studios, where he recorded his best-selling album "Bat Out Of Hell," to confront the ghostly encounter that has haunted him for decades.
Young and the Restless actress Melody Thomas Scott returns to the home in Sherman Oaks, California she fled decades ago after a face to face meeting with a desperate spirit.
Keisha Knight Pulliam encounters a lingering family spirit; while making renovations on her new house, Ming-Na discovers a previous owner is reluctant to leave.
A protective spirit saves Brett Butler from an abusive relationship; a murdered man threatens Cassandra Peterson's life in her own home; lonely spirits stalk Phil Varone.
Stuart enters a previously unexplored area of the prison and it seems that he is not alone.
Filmed as a live show backup during COVID, this unseen vigil sees Karl, Gregg, and Stuart explore the eerie underbelly of a haunted location under strict safety guidelines.
Karl enters the haunted stable block and soon realises he is not alone.
Stuart walks the first floor of this old manor house to find what is said to haunt its corridors.
Glen explores Aberdeen’s haunted Tivoli Theatre, attempting to contact a stagehand ghost who died 80 years ago but has been seen there ever since.
After Guillermo Del Toro’s social media post about paranormal activity at his hotel, Gregg went to investigate the strange happenings firsthand.
Karl enters a cottage so haunted its owners keep its location secret. Inside, the atmosphere shifts to fear as a dark force reveals its power.
Karl enters Guys Cliffe House’s old stable block alone and soon senses the powerful spiritual energy said to haunt its dark corners.
Stuart investigates the two Masonic lodges at this very haunted location in search of the spirits of the long dead.
Karl explores HMP Gloucester, one of the UK’s most haunted prisons. Alone in the largest block and execution cell, he soon encounters an unworldly presence.
Stuart enters Gloucester Prison’s Hospital Wing and quickly senses an unseen presence sharing the space with him.
Gregg investigates C-Wing which was built on top of an earlier Georgian prison and gets more than he bargained for.
Yvette & Karl investigate a jewel in the crown of Great Britain, Ruthin Castle. They take on the infamous room 222 and soon realise they are not alone.
Karl & Stuart take on one of the Most Haunted rooms in this ancient castle. Whatever is there, seems desperate to make itself known.
Karl ventures alone into the underneath Leeds Town Hall into the dark prison cells that is said to be haunted by a plethora of unhappy spirits, one doesn’t seem happy that Karl is there.
Karl & Stu investigate the attic of Hodroyd Hall, and soon become witness to the many strange occurances. What or who is trying to make contact?
Yvette, Karl & Stuart investigate the pride of Rochdale, Champness Hall. With loud footsteps and strange noises, the team seem to be followed by a persistent spirit.
There are many ghost said to haunt Gloucester Prison, from the passive to the most aggressive and as Stuart enters the segregation block he soon fears for his life.
